content: flutter_rust_bridge v2: stable 2.13.0 (Aug 2026), prerelease 2.14.0-beta.2 (Sep 2026). Flutter Favorite, actively maintained, Rust+Dart FFI codegen with async Rust, streams, Rust-calls-Dart. Compiles Rust as DLL into the app (Cargokit/native assets). FlClash's rust_api plugin uses FRB 2.13.0 for a thin Rust helper (IPC server, hotkey) while business payloads go as raw bytes over that pipe.
